claim: Canonical/duplicate content crisis — /best-office-chairs/ mirrors /office-chairs-for-tall-people/ (identical title, meta, canonical)
why: Not a page. It is a 301 redirect to /office-chairs-for-tall-people/ (public/_redirects:7, verified HTTP 301 2026-08-05). The audit used default fetch(), which follows redirects, so it compared the destination page against itself. The 2026-07-04 consolidation created this redirect deliberately.
rule: Never report duplicate content, canonical, or cannibalization issues between a redirect source and its target — that is a completed merge, not a defect.
